new_results.statement: For independent real X,Y with density caps m_X,m_Y and every invertible indefinite physical 2x2 quadratic matrix B, including arbitrary affine terms, the output density satisfies ||p||_3 <= 22 |det B|^(-1/3) (m_X m_Y)^(2/3).
For a literal physical block [[a,t,0],[t,b,0],[0,0,lambda]] with t^2-ab>0 and lambda!=0, arbitrary ambient extensions and cap-one product inputs have a C0 density bounded by 44 |det B3|^(-1/3).
For a literal coupled physical 3x3 block with nonzero pivot lambda and indefinite Schur pair, ||p_Q||_infinity <= 4*22^(3/4)|lambda|^(-1/4)|det B3|^(-1/4); continuity not newly claimed.

rank_two_control: For independent Uniform[-1/2,1/2] X,Y, p_(2XY)(r)=log(1/(2|r|)) for 0<|r|<1/2 and ||p_(2XY)||_3^3=6.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: On the b=0 boundary [[a,t,0],[t,0,0],[0,0,lambda]], ||p_Q||_infinity <= 6(|t|^2|lambda|)^(-1/3); in particular t=1, |lambda|=1 gives <=6 for arbitrary ambient extensions.

remaining_implication: QFORM-INDEFINITE-PAIR-L3-NULLPIVOT-COMPILER-v1: remove the |lambda|^(-1/4) loss for the general coupled physical triple as the usable majority-sign physical pivot vanishes, while retaining original-coordinate product provenance and nonzero third shear; global extraction and arbitrary nonseparable additional spectrum remain separate.
